methodology.unit: A passing workflow with reviewed outcome state, safeguards, and operating limits.
methodology.generation: Every applicable outcome-first operator is applied once per eligible state leaf, invariant, or budget.
methodology.oracle: The state-only profile checks expected state; the outcome-contract profile also checks invariants and budgets.
methodology.scoring: A mutation is killed only when a metric passes on the original and fails on the mutated case.
methodology.reproducibility: Suite bytes, aggregate summaries, schemas, and expected profile results are pinned.
